title: fix(plugin-detail): the record meta line leaves the owner out only when the strip the page drew carries it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUa7sLpBRCGenWhqEBnN1ho)_

Fixes #28909

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:记录页正文下方的元信息行，现在只在「页面实际画出的要点条」里有 `owner_id` 时才省略负责人。`RecordMetaFooter` 新增可选属性 `drawnHighlightFields`,由画要点条的宿主(`RecordDetailView`)把它实际画出的字段交给页脚;不传时仍按对象声明的 `highlightFields` 判断，行为不变。
- **为什么改**:#28868 让负责人只出现一次，但页脚问的是声明列表(最多 6 个),而手机记录头在副标题后最多只画 4 个。`owner_id` 声明在第 5、6 位且前面是四个非文本字段时，手机页上要点条和元信息行都不显示负责人，用户看不到记录归谁。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只影响默认记录页和带插槽的记录页上「负责人写不写在元信息行」这一处;桌面端结果不变。无新元数据键、无新门禁。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(`drawnHighlightFieldsOf` 与两个 `RecordMetaFooter` 调用点)、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`(`stripFields` 一行)、`RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordMetaFooter.drawnStrip-28909.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、6 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`RecordMetaFooter` gains one optional prop, `drawnHighlightFields?: readonly string[]`**: the fields the page's highlight strip actually draws, handed over by the host that draws it. The meta line leaves the owner out only when this list carries `owner_id`. When the prop is omitted, the footer asks `deriveHighlightFields(objectSchema, null)` as before, so other hosts (the standalone `DetailView`, the Studio page preview) are unchanged.
- **`RecordDetailView` hands the footer the strip it rendered, at both call sites** (the laid-out page's details foot and the page-foot append). A module-level reader, `drawnHighlightFieldsOf(page)`, collects the `fields` of the `record:highlights` blocks among `renderedPage`'s top-level blocks, in either form the block accepts (a bare name or a `{ name }` entry). That is where the synthesizer places the strip, so the list is:
  - on a phone, the header's strip after the subtitle (at most `PHONE_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`, four);
  - on a desktop, the declared strip (at most six);
  - on a slotted page, the page's own `highlights` slot.
- **The plugin-detail README** ("The provenance footer belongs to the record page") now tells a host that draws a strip to pass `drawnHighlightFields`.
- **File surface:** the claim, amended in 6569734511 to add the drawn-strip reader with its one const in `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md`.
- `recordPhoneHeader.ts` is read, not edited. `DetailView.tsx` is not edited: its footer runs outside `DefaultRecordPageContext`, so it never names the owner, and on a record page the page draws the footer instead.

## Tests

- **New: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909.test.tsx`**, a real `RecordDetailView` mount on the `phoneFace-27058` harness. The lead declares `highlightFields: ['name', 'email', 'status', 'phone', 'website', 'owner_id']`: the title, four non-text highlights, then the owner fifth.
  - At 390 px the strip has 4 entries without the owner, and the meta line names 「Ada Admin」.
  - At 1440 px the strip has 5 entries with the owner, and the meta line has no owner entry (its id entry is still drawn).
- **New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordMetaFooter.drawnStrip-28909.test.tsx`**, 4 cases on the prop: drawn strip without the owner (declared with it) keeps the owner; drawn strip with the owner (declared without it) drops it; an empty drawn strip keeps it; omitted, the declared strip decides.
- `RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnce-28868.test.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` re-run green unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **The strip is read from top-level blocks only.** A `record:highlights` block nested inside a container in an authored `highlights` slot is not collected. The meta line then keeps the owner, which can name it twice but never zero times. The synthesizer itself always places the strip at the top level.
- **Field-level security is not subtracted.** The `record:highlights` renderer also drops fields the reader may not see (`enforceFieldSecurity`, `redactFields`). When the owner is withheld from the strip that way, it is withheld from the record row too, so the meta line has no owner value to show either.
- The shared `HighlightFieldsContext` registry (what the highlights renderer registers for the details body) was not used: the claim asks for an explicit prop from the host, and the registry fills in an effect after the first paint.

## Verification

All readings are on this branch at head `be4cc7d0` (base `ff881050`). `origin/main` has moved 10 commits since; none touches `plugin-detail` or `app-shell/src/views`, so `main` is not merged in. Commands ran under `os-verify-lock`.

- Footer leg: the `drawnHighlightFields ??` read removed in `RecordMetaFooter`. 4 failed and 2 passed: the three prop cases and the phone page case.
